raw_response:
I am old now, 60 years, and I been farming here in Quzhou 35 years. I never went to school, but my hands know the soil. My 12 mu, I split them like I always do — wheat and maize same land, two crop one year, and some cotton on the side for extra money.

Let me think. Last year my wheat did okay, maybe 450 kilo per mu. Maize more, about 550 kilo. Cotton is harder, price not good these years, but I keep 2 mu because my wife picks it and we sell to the buyer who comes.

For wheat, I plant in October after maize come out. I use the improved seed the dealer sells — everybody in village use it now, my neighbor Old Zhang say his son bring from town. I put 2 bag of compound fertilizer before planting, that is maybe 50 kilo each bag, and then urea in spring when wheat turn green, one bag. That come to maybe 18 kilo nitrogen I think, phosphorus maybe 8, potassium 6. I water 3 time — before winter, after green-up, and when grain fill. I spray 2 time for aphid and rust.

For maize, summer crop after wheat. I use hybrid seed, the kind with red bag. I broadcast compound before planting, then topdress urea when knee-high. Maize eat more nitrogen than wheat, I put more — maybe 20 kilo. Phosphorus 7, potassium 6. Water 2 time if rain no come. Spray 1 time for borer.

For cotton, 2 mu only. I do like before. Cotton need more work but I know it. Nitrogen 15, phosphorus 8, potassium 10. Spray many time, 5 time, because bollworm always come. Water 3 time.

I no plough deep — cost too much diesel. I use rotary, the small tractor come from village service.
